title: An ARN operator value with fewer than six fields
question: AWS checks each of an ARN's six fields separately in the ARN operators, and doesn't say how a value with fewer fields matches. The analyzer refuses.

cases.name: three_fields
cases.description: ArnLike arn:aws:sns, against a full SNS topic ARN.

readings.ALLOW: it is completed with * fields, as a short Resource ARN is

cases.name: four_fields_ending_in_star
cases.description: ArnLike arn:aws:sns:*, against a full SNS topic ARN.

readings.ALLOW: it is completed, or its last * runs on to the end
